title: 第8章 美女们“围攻”傻大壮
novel_title: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
李大壮手上动作不停，同时冷声问张振生。

    “呵！一个傻子，还真惦记上我的副院长之位了！”张振生像是听到什么笑话似的，脸上的老褶都挤到了一起，大声嘲笑：“行！你要是真有这能耐，别说副院长了，我还愿意向你磕头拜师！”

    “这可是你说的！”李大壮似笑非笑的回头看了他一眼。

    不知道为啥，这傻子的一个眼神，竟让张振生莫名一慌！

    下一秒，他就听见了林晚禾倒抽气的声音：“缝，缝上了！真的缝上了！！”

    “什么！？不可能！！”

    张振生不敢置信的扑过去，果然看到李守义断掉的食指，竟然已经完好无损的回到了他的手上！

    更令他目瞪口呆的是，断指的连接处，竟然一点缝合的痕迹都没有，就好像这根手指从来没断过似的！

    “不！不可能！这根本不可能啊！”张振生狠狠的在自己脸上抽了两巴掌！

    疼！不是做梦！

    他见鬼了似的看着李大壮，李大壮却连个眼神都没给他，只是专心的继续缝合着下一根手指！

    倒是已经彻底惊呆的张桂芬和李秋霜，被张振生大耳刮子的声音给惊醒了，激动的浑身颤抖！

    “大壮真行！我儿子真行啊！这下可好了，不用去县医院花大钱，也能保住老头子的手指了！”

    “妈，大壮这回好了以后，本事更大了，以后你和我爸都可以放心了！”

    李大壮手指翻飞，又快又稳，没一会儿，就把父亲断掉的四根手指，全都接上了，而且全都没有缝合的痕迹，就和自己长上去似的，十分完美！

    “这，这简直太不可思议了！”林晚禾一直在近距离观察李大壮的动作，两团雪白贴在李大壮胳膊上，因为激动微微颤抖着，之前李大壮没心情感受，这会儿细细品味一下，其实两个圆润的触感不同，也是别有一番风味嘛！
content_en:
What Li Dazhuang said was clear and logical. Although Zhang Guifen didn't believe that her son could really connect his wife's fingers, she did believe that he might not be stupid anymore!

    Idiots don't speak so neatly!

    "Mom and Dad, Da Zhuang is indeed not stupid anymore!" Li Qiu Shuang nodded vigorously to her parents.

    Only then did the two elders of the Li family completely believe it. Huge surprises filled their hearts. Zhang Guifen excitedly patted her son's strong arms, her eyes blurred with tears again:

    "Okay, okay! Da Zhuang, you are fine! God finally opened his eyes!"

    Li Shouyi also trembled and said, "I...my hands don't need...healing anymore. He's strong enough. Save money to...find him a wife!"

    Li Dazhuang looked at his rickety old parents, his heart was extremely sour, and his eyes were a little moist: "Mom and Dad, let's go home and talk about the rest, but now, I have to quickly connect my dad's finger!"

    "Excuse me, do you have silver needles for acupuncture? Can you lend them to me?" Li Dazhuang asked the doctors and nurses in the consulting room.

    "Family members of the patient, are you sure that this man in your family is really not stupid? Judging from my many years of experience as a doctor, he is not only stupid, but also very stupid!"

    An older male doctor said rudely: "Listen to what he just said. He used acupuncture to connect bones and flesh. It's a joke. If he really has this ability, I will give him the position of vice president!"

    Several coquettish-looking young nurses also looked at Li Dazhuang with mocking expressions, and only one sexy, graceful and beautiful female doctor said anxiously: "Everyone, now is not the time to be angry, it is business to send the patient to the county hospital quickly!"

    "The best time to reattach a severed finger is only six to eight hours. Two hours have passed now. It will take you at least half an hour to reach the county seat. Every minute is urgent!"

    "Thank you for reminding me, but I'm really not talking stupidly. If you can help me get a pair of silver needles, and when I connect them to my dad's fingers, I can help you treat your breast problems for free!"

    Li Dazhuang could tell at a glance that this beautiful female doctor had one big breast and one small. Although she used silicone pads to raise the smaller one, Li Dazhuang, who has the inheritance of Meier, has extraordinary eyesight!

    The delicate and beautiful face of the female doctor turned red instantly, her seemingly plump and round chest was rising and falling due to her urgent breathing, her red lips were slightly opened in shock, and her beautiful eyes were full of disbelief!

    She blurted out excitedly: "I obviously put latex pads in my underwear and no one else noticed it. How did you idiot figure it out!?"

    Everyone in the clinic opened their mouths in surprise. What that fool said was actually true!
